triggerReasons.message: Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: A root pretest script builds packages/main then packages/utils before the full suite, so npm test self-bootstraps packages/utils/dist and the full suite (including bin/lattice.js sub-tests) starts without the missing-utils bootstrap failure.
acceptanceBindings.note: Verified by the repro-first RED (node packages/main/tests/red/red-fb7b-pretest-builds-utils.mjs) and a fast structural smoke wired into validate.commands. verificationIntentRefs added after the test-intent subagent runs.
